name: The provider's side
blurb: Practices and hospitals answering algorithmic denials with their own automation, and the documentation that survives a model's review.

points.desc: The American Medical Association's 2025 prior authorization survey, released May 2026, found physicians completing about 40 prior authorizations a week, 32 percent saying requests are often or always denied, and only 24 percent saying denials are consistently reviewed by an appropriately qualified clinician.
points.name: What physicians report

points.desc: On June 23, 2025, more than 50 insurers committed through AHIP to clinician review of every medical necessity denial, 90 day continuity when a member changes plans, fewer services subject to prior authorization from 2026, and real-time answers on 80 percent of electronic approvals in 2027. The pledge carries no enforcement.
points.name: The industry pledge
